ir3_community.topic: Iran's Jewish community: antiquity, population, constitution, reserved seat, institutions, Khomeini 1979, wartime statements

claims.text: Persian Jewish presence traced to 8th-century BCE Assyrian deportations ('over 2,700 years'); Cyrus allowed return to Judea (537 BCE per page); before 1979 about 80,000 Jews (Tehran 60,000, Shiraz 8,000, Kermanshah 4,000, Isfahan 3,000); census 8,756 and 9,826 (2016); about 100 synagogues as of 2025; Muslim-appointed heads of Jewish schools, Saturday opening required until 4 Feb 2015; Dr Sapir hospital; Khomeini met delegation led by Yedidia Shofet three days after Elghanian execution; Ettela'at headline 'We do not believe that all Jews are Zionists'

Tomb of Esther and Mordechai, Hamadan: Iranian Jewish and Christian tradition; Herzfeld proposed Shushandukht; arson attempt May 2020, Molotov attack 3 April 2024 minor damage; chief rabbi read Book of Esther there 14 March 2025

1956 census 65,232 Jews; about 60,000 at 1979 per Statistical Centre (1986); 1948 ~150,000 per Tablet (estimates conflict); 2009 State Dept 20,000-25,000; 2016 census 9,826; Littman: ~30,000 left within months of revolution; Parsi quotes Khomeini 'We recognize our Jews as separate from those godless, bloodsucking Zionists' (Treacherous Alliance p.8); Albert Danialpour executed 5 June 1980
AFP 29 July 2012: 2011 census counted 8,756 Jews (earlier estimate about 20,000), 117,704 Christians, 25,271 Zoroastrians; figures posted by presidency's planning department

State Dept 2014 IRF report: 'Iranian census statistics in 2012 reported there were fewer than 9,000 Jews, while media estimate there are as many as 25,000'; government discriminated against all religious minorities in employment, education, housing

Oct 30 2023 rallies of Iranian Jews in five cities against Israel; State Dept called reported coercion 'abhorrent'; Tehran Jewish Committee estimate about 9,000; a community member gave 20,000 in 2021

Hakakian (Tablet, 2014): Elghanian executed 9 May 1979, charged with 'friendship with Israel, Zionists, and the enemies of God, and sowing corruption on earth'; delegation of two rabbis and four young men visited Khomeini in Qom 10 May 1979; Khomeini: 'We recognize our Jews as separate from those godless, bloodsucking Zionists'; over 100,000 in 1970s; government reports 25,000, author estimates no more than 10,000; community as 'living political citation'

Constitution Art. 13: 'Zoroastrian, Jewish, and Christian Iranians are the only recognized religious minorities' free within the law to perform rites and follow own canon in personal status and religious education; Art. 14 fair treatment applies to those who do not conspire against Islam or the Republic; Art. 64 'The Zoroastrians and Jews will each elect one representative', Assyrian/Chaldean one, Armenians two; Art. 115 president must be from 'religious and political personalities' and believe in the official school; the text does not mention Zionism
Homayoun Sameh Najafabadi Jewish MP since 2020; told VOA in 2024 government aid to Jewish institutions had 'increased greatly'

Ynet 17 June 2025: about 15,000 Jews (80,000 before 1979); community issued two statements condemning Israel; Sameh wrote Israel 'is committing war crimes — crimes against humanity'; minority MPs' joint statement via Fars; fear of vigilante violence; anonymous sources

June 2025: HRANA said at least 35 Jews in Tehran and Shiraz summoned for questioning from 23 June, warned not to contact relatives in Israel; Mehr photos of Jews gathering at Abrishami synagogue in support of Khamenei; radio host Amrani said gathering meant to 'avert any suspicion of spying'; ToI estimate 8,000-10,000

Iranian Jewish Association called 7 April 2026 strike on Tehran synagogue 'heinous', affirmed 'historic unity with the Leader, the Iranian nation'; Israeli official told ToI 'Israel doesn't target synagogues'

RNS 9 April 2026: Rafi-Nia synagogue in Tehran leveled in strike overnight 6-7 April; Sameh: 'The synagogue building was completely destroyed and our Torah scrolls were left under the rubble'; IDF said target was senior Khatam al-Anbiya member, regretted collateral damage; 8,000-15,000 Jews, about 100,000 before 1979; no casualties reported
Iran International (opposition-leaning, London) Dec 2025: Jewish MP Sameh said he was summoned by security agencies over Jewish users' likes and comments on Israeli content

Audit re-check: Elghanian executed 9 May 1979; delegation of 'two rabbis and four young intellectuals' to Qom on 10 May 1979; Khomeini's sentence 'painted on the walls of every synagogue, Hebrew school, and kosher butcheries by nightfall'; Hakakian calls 25,000 'bloated governmental statistics'

Audit re-check: 'more than 80% of the remaining Iranian Jews fled or emigrated from the country between 1979 and 2006' (Mahdi and Daniel 2006); Jews without passports crossed on foot to Turkey or Pakistan

Audit re-check: RNS dates the strike 'overnight Monday (April 6)'; IDF 'regrets the collateral damage'; AP caption citing security official: strike destroyed half the synagogue and nearby residential buildings
Audit re-check: Ynet reported no prayers in synagogues during the June 2025 fighting; Hamadan struck; Lalehzar described as senior community leader

Audit re-check: State Department 2023: Iran's officials 'regularly spread antisemitic views'; rallies 30 October 2023 in Tehran, Shiraz, Isfahan, Yazd, Kermanshah; Tehran Jewish Committee estimate of about 9,000 cited in the State Department religious freedom report

ir3_facts.topic: The other fact: Elghanian, restrictions, Shiraz trial, Ghahremani execution, Holocaust denial, leaders' statements, wartime arrests, synagogue strike, Israel's framing

claims.text: AP 2 July 2000: Shiraz revolutionary court convicted 10 Jews and 2 Muslims, acquitted 3 Jews and 2 Muslims; sentences 4-13 years; charges 'cooperating with a hostile government, membership in an illegal (spy) ring and recruitment of new agents'; eight confessed, two confessions aired on state TV; Israel denied they worked for it; Clinton 'deeply disappointed'; MP Maurice Motamed said verdicts 'seriously affected the community'

AP 21 Sept 2000: Fars appeals court overturned spy-ring and recruitment convictions, upheld cooperation with Israel; terms cut to 2-9 years; official Amiri: 'the ultimate of Islamic kindness and generosity'
JTA 19 Feb 2003: 13 Jews detained January and March 1999; last five freed February 2003

AFP 4 Nov 2024: Arvin Ghahremani hanged in Kermanshah prison for murder in a street fight; IHR said case had 'significant flaws' and antisemitism likely played a role; judiciary's Mizan said victim's family 'refused to give consent' to blood money

Ghahremani: killing of Amir Shokri, Kermanshah, Nov 2022; family claims self-defence, prosecutor says intentional; Supreme Court denied retrial 25 May 2024; hanged 4 Nov 2024 without notice; first Jew executed in Iran since 1994 (per page); some Iranian Jews told VOA it was an ordinary murder case; activists say law usually requires death when a non-Muslim kills a Muslim but compensation in reverse; Israel FM Persian account condemned; Lipstadt condemned 6 Nov

Dec 11-12 2006 Tehran conference organised by Foreign Ministry's IPIS; 67 attendees from 30 countries incl. David Duke, Faurisson, six Neturei Karta members; Mottaki said it was 'neither to deny nor prove'; Ahmadinejad: 'Zionist regime will be wiped out soon the same way the Soviet Union was'; Jewish MP Maurice Motamed criticised it; condemned by UN SG, Merkel, Olmert, US, EU
Khamenei 20 March 2014 Mashhad: Holocaust 'an event whose reality is uncertain'; Zarif Sept 2013: 'Iran never denied it'
Khamenei 22 May 2020: 'The Zionist regime (Israel) is a cancerous tumor in the region'

Khamenei Twitter Nov 2014: Israel 'has no cure but to be annihilated'; elimination does not mean 'massacre of the Jewish people'; referendum of 'original people of Palestine including Muslims, Christians, and Jews'; Jewish immigrants excluded from vote

Freedom House 2026 (covering 2025): constitution recognises Zoroastrians, Jews, certain Christians, 'relatively free to worship'; five reserved seats; non-Shiite religious minorities 'rarely awarded senior government posts'; at least 35 Jews interrogated in Shiraz and Tehran, warned not to contact relatives in Israel

USCIRF 2026 report (covering 2025): authorities 'systematically arrested Jews in Isfahan, Yazd, Shiraz, and Tehran'; pressured leaders to voice support; 'held Jews collectively responsible for Israeli actions'; annual Holocaust cartoon competition; Mashhad imam Alam al-Hoda called Holocaust stories 'a complete lie'
Netanyahu video 13 June 2025: 'Our fight is against the murderous Islamic regime that oppresses and impoverishes you'

Rafi'-Nia synagogue, Tehran, built 1958; strike 7 April 2026 hit adjacent building; IDF later confirmed damage, said target was senior commander of Khatam al-Anbiya emergency command, called it collateral damage and expressed regret; two people rescued from rubble; Iran's Diaspora Affairs Ministry suggested destruction claim exaggerated; former MP Moreh Sedgh said no military activity at site
IDF statement fragments: target 'a senior commander in Khatam al-Anbiya', 'collateral damage', 'precise munitions and aerial surveillance'
Iran International 28 July 2025: five Iranian Jews still detained on suspicion of collaborating with Israel, one a US citizen
Audit re-check: Motamed said the conference 'has upset Iran's 25,000-strong Jewish community' and 'put a lot of pressure on Jews all over the world'

Audit re-check: closed Shiraz trial, judge also acting as prosecutor; two Muslims convicted received two years each; Israeli officials said the men 'never worked for the Jewish state'; Barak called on the international community to press Iran
Audit re-check: Fars judiciary chief Hossein Ali Amiri: 'These sentences are the lowest possible sentences and we have used the ultimate of Islamic kindness and generosity'

Audit re-check: IHR's Amiry-Moghaddam: 'institutionalized anti-Semitism in the Islamic republic undoubtedly played a crucial role in the execution of his sentence'; AFP: execution of a Jewish Iranian 'unprecedented in recent years'; community 'the largest in the Middle East outside Israel'
Audit re-check: Ghahremani page: provincial prosecutor said 'the killing was intentional'; 'the first Jewish person executed in Iran since 1994'
Audit re-check: Freedom House 2026: 'Baha'is are systematically persecuted, sentenced to prison, and banned from access to higher education'
